source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide where a fertilised egg develops in birds compared with most mammals.

intelligence.enrichment: In birds, the fertilised egg is laid and the zygote develops into an embryo during hatching; in most mammals, the zygote develops into an embryo inside the female body, where the mother's body supplies food and oxygen until birth. place of development after fertilisation -> source of food and oxygen -> embryo growth until hatching or birth The learner correctly uses the chapter relationship: In birds, the fertilised egg is laid and the zygote develops into an embryo during hatching; in most mammals, the zygote develops into an embryo inside the female body, where the mother's body supplies food and oxygen until birth. All animals develop fertilised eggs the same way once sperm reaches the egg.
